source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Wireless Network Connections' of 1.9 as printed (PDF 17, printed 12).

blocks.text: A wireless network connects devices without using cables. It uses radio signals to send and receive data. Wi-Fi is the most common wireless technology used in homes. Devices can move freely within the network range. Wireless networks are easy to install and use. They may be slower than wired networks in some cases.
